topic: Applying factors and aggregating predicted data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on applying historical factors to campaign data. It was determined that the factor application period should be standardized, specifically suggesting setting the start date for all campaigns (including '19') to September 17th, rather than varying dates like October 1st or December 22nd.

Separately, a request was made to aggregate predicted data to check the resulting unique user count. A difficulty was noted regarding selecting all sensors belonging to a single category within Mops.
decisions: The factor application start date for campaigns should be standardized to September 17th.
action_items: [me] will aggregate the predicted data and report back on the unique user count.
Investigate a method or ticket for selecting all sensors belonging to one category in Mops.
